description: Named, dated OSV/license exceptions. Each entry must include reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries fail scripts/check-supply-chain-exceptions.mjs. OSV ignore IDs must also appear in osv-scanner.toml IgnoredVulns.

exceptions.reason: Path traversal in @hono/node-server serve-static on Windows; transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (^1.19.x). Fix requires major 2.0.5; Construct does not expose untrusted Windows static serving through this adapter. Revisit when MCP SDK depends on @hono/node-server ^2.

sharp <0.35 via next@16 optionalDependency ^0.34.5; override to 0.35.x breaks the caret. Same class as LanceDB pin note in docs/guides/reference/dependencies.md. Revisit when Next allows sharp >=0.35.

Nested lodash-es@4.17.21 _.template injection under chevrotain (docs tooling). Construct does not evaluate untrusted lodash templates from this path.

brace-expansion DoS nested under cacache's minimatch, pulled transitively by node-gyp -> make-fetch-happen -> @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-library (SBOM dev tooling, not shipped). npm audit propagates this single advisory's severity up through minimatch/glob/cacache/make-fetch-happen/node-gyp/libxmljs2 in the same chain. Fix requires a major @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm downgrade (4.0.1) that reintroduces GHSA-v75r-vx73-82pj; not a net improvement. Revisit when cyclonedx-library drops the node-gyp/cacache chain; construct-h6qjb.
